comment: This was a really fun class and Prof. Brown makes the material interesting and through dramatic tales and reenactments. She also does not try to be politically correct and patronizing like so many other professors. I thought her exams were fair and I learned a lot.

Carol has us read her book, which is her version of property. I still do not know what I learned, probably because I did not learn anything. I had to teach myself during her lectures. Her exam made me borderline pass out, and I hold a hate in my heart for this class. If you get her, do anything to switch out lmao. Thank god this is over. Was hell.

Lectures are frantic and off topic, professor uses the time to act out her dreams of being a soap opera star (as stated multiple times by her). Does not cold call, expects you to interrupt her by yelling if you have questions. Will ask questions then answer then herself without looking up. Final exam tests on concepts we never discussed in class.

This professor is very knowledgeable about her subject matter and is very passionate, however she is so passionate that she does not know how to explain her subject people who don't know it already. She often sidetracks and rants about political issues and will interrupt and argue with you in class if you make a point she does not agree with.
